hero.source: A Picture It Might Be Well To Hang On the Walls Of the State Capitol
hero.description: A man, whose coat is labelled Minn Legislature, is standing in front of a large framed picture hanging on the wall. The picture appears to be the damage of a fire in a small community. The Minneapolis Tribune reported on October 9, about a fire in Beltrami county which claimed 250 lives.
